Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, west Triangle, Quezon City http: IlvaM.v. dilg.gov.ph OPINION No. HON. CESAR S. ITURRALDE 1 SEP 2017 City Vice Mayor Office of the Vice Mayor R T Lim Boulevard Zamboanga City Dear Vice Mayor Iturralde: s. 20E This is in reference your letter dated 14 December 2016 to Dir. Paisal O. Abutazil, Regional Director, DILG Region IX which was indorsed to this Office and received on 10 January 2017 relative to your request for guidance on the following issues, viz.: I. What is the legal basis for the conduct of the annual State of the City Address? 2. What is the protocol to be observed during such event? 3. If only Local Chief Executive will deliver the report during such event, will there be any violation of the Local Government Code or other pertinent laws and circular? It appears that the issues you raised were interrelated with one another, thus, this Office deemed it proper to answer the same in one thorough discussion. Historically, the State of the City Address - is a speech customarily given once each year by the mayors of many cities in the United States and Canada, and commonly called as State of the City Address (SOCA). Other international cities have also adopted the tradition; for example, the Executive Mayor of Johannesburg has delivered a State of the City Address since 2002. In Corning, New York the "State of the City Address" has been replaced by the "Status of the Administration Address" given by the City Manager who serves as the City's Chief Executive Officer rather than the Mayor. 1 1 https://en.wikipedia.orWwiki/State_of_the_City_address

(3 In the Philippines, it is called SOCA for cities, State of Municipality Address (SOMA) for municipalities or State of the Province Address (SOP A) for provinces. This practice of some LGUs may be an offshoot of the President's State of the Nation Address (SONA), as mandated by the 1987 Constitution, specifically Article VII, Section 23 thereof, which is held every fourth (4th) Monday of July at the opening of the joint session of the Congress. Article VII, Section 23 provides: "The President shall address the Congress at the opening of its regular session. He may also appear before at any other time. " Although not all LGUs practiced the so-called "SOMA", "SOCA" or "SOP A", this finds legal bases under the Local Government Code, particularly Sections 444(b)(I)(iii), 455 (b)(l)(iii), and 465 (b)(iii) which provide as follows: Section 444. The Chief Executive: Powers, Duties, Functions and Compensation. (b) For efficient, effective and economical governance the purpose of which is the general welfare of the municipality and its inhabitants pursuant to Section 16 of this Code, the municipal mayor shall: (1) Exercise general supervision and control over all programs, projects, services, and activities of the municipal government, and in this connection, shall: (iii) At the opening of the regular session of the sangguniang bayan for every calendar year and, as may be deemed necessary, present the program of government and propose policies and projects for the consideration of the sangguniang bayan as the general welfare OT the inhabitants and the needs of the municipal government may require; Section 455. Chief Executive; Powers, Duties and Compensation. (b) For efficient, effective and economical governance the purpose of which is the general welfare of the city and its inhabitants pursuant to Section 16 of this Code, the city mayor shall:

(l) Exercise general supervision and control over all programs, projects, services, and activities of the city government. and in this connection, shall: (iii) Present the program of government and propose policies and projects for the consideration OT the sangguniang panlungsod at the opening of the regular session of the sangguniang panlungsod every calendar year and as often as may be deemed necessary as the general welfare of the inhabitants and the needs of the city government may require; Section 465. The Chief Executive: Powers, Duties, Functions and Compensation. (b) For efficient, effective and economical governance the purpose of which is the general welfare of the province and its inhabitants pursuant to Section 16 of this Code, the provincial governor shall: (iii) Present the program of government and propose policies and projects for the consideration of the sangguniang panlalawigan at the opening of the regular session of the sangguniang panlalavvigan every calendar year and as often as may be deemed necessary as the general welfare of the inhabitants and the needs of the city go vernment may require; With the foregoing discussions above, it can be gleaned that it was included in the duties of the Governor, City/MunicipaI Mayor to address the Sanggunian at the opening of the session or as often as may be deemed necessary to present the programs, projects and other needs of the LGU. This duty was granted only to the Governor and City/Municipal Mayor and not to other officials in the Province, City or Municipality. Hence, there was no violation of any law or issuances if the Local Chief Executive will be the only person who will deliver a report in the said event. Meanwhile, even if the LGC is explicit in the above-mentioned duty of the Governors and Mayors, nothing however in the said law precludes the Punong Barangay from doing the same even if he/she is the presiding officer in the Sanggunian Barangay session.

As to the protocol to be observed in the conduct of such event, this Department has no existing specific guidelines or issuance relative thereto. However, those concerned shall be guided by Sections 444(b)(1)(iii), 455(b)(iii) and 465(b)(iii) that the SOMA, SOCA or SOPA has the objective of presenting the programs of the government and proposed policies and projects for consideration of the sangguniang panlalawigan/panlunsod/ bayan. Lastly, it should be observed in such a manner that the purpose of the said event will be achieved, and as organize and peaceful as possible. We hope we have addressed your concern accordingly cc. Dir. Paisal O. Abutazil Regional Director DILG RO IX Pagadian City Very truly yours, AUST RE A. PANADERO Undersecretary 201 -0 08-0
